_doc: R3 P1 §4b — the REVIEWED region registry (codex P1 plan r3 P1-1). One entry per generated region (contract/regions.json), keyed by region id. status: pending (inventoried; adapter not built) | terminal { observable, action, facts? } (compared in gate A at its own observable, exposed by action) | via { target, reason } (not separately visible; asserted at region target). The keys must EQUAL the generated inventory (region.guard): a new consumer call site without an entry is RED.
